Name: render_prompt
Description: Render an effective catalog template with project context and output requirements for Codex to execute. Returns a self-contained task, target UUID, expected_revision and write instructions. Fragments also return fragment_prompt. Before page image generation, compose chapter/section_image with target=page, chapter_uuid/page_uuid and effective before_image_prompt/reference_usage_text fragments in variables; use the full generation_prompt and image_write_back, not the outer task prompt/write_back. No provider is called. Supply missing task inputs in variables. Narrow context_chapter_uuids/context_setting_uuids if the result is too large.

Name: setting_boards
Description: List/get host-generated setting boards, or import an actual host image path as one resumable batch. Import preserves the original pixels and records source text/style/prompt without a provider. expected_revision is settings list premise.revision. Get returns source, setting_image.asset (read_image reference), board revision and latest committed breakdown. Replay an import with its original key and input even if the host file expired.

Name: apply_setting_breakdown
Description: Apply YOUR visual analysis to a saved board: deterministic crops and all setting/version bindings commit atomically, with no provider call. Use normalized non-overlapping crop_box coordinates from the actual image. Existing settings require setting_uuid and that setting's expected_revision; omitted UUID creates only and rejects existing titles. expected_revision is board.revision; expected_premise_revision is settings list premise.revision. Replay exactly the same request/key to recover; reread after conflict. Returns immutable output UUIDs, not a new generation.

Name: image_target
Description: Before host image generation, read the target ratio, closest common host ratio, composition guidance, suggested crop/pad and current revision. For page_image, setting_readiness reports reusable and missing setting images. Omit setting_uuids to inventory candidates, then select only settings needed by this page; missing_images means prepare them first. Empty selection is not readiness approval. First-page limits do not skip setting images. This does not return the image prompt: for page_image, also render_prompt chapter/section_image target=page and use its full generation_prompt with the matching image_write_back revision. The common host ratio does not override the project canvas or layout. Settings use a square reference canvas; scenes follow the book ratio. No generation or provider call.

setting_uuids.description: page_image only. Active setting UUIDs needed for this page, in reference order. Omit to inventory project candidates; [] explicitly selects none, not ready. Only an explicit user instruction can waive missing setting images.
